propositions: Diagnostic artifacts (transcript.md, diag_runaway_transcript.py, diag_runaway_matrix.py) existed on impl-10ae-verifier-ctx branch but were not ancestors of origin/main, making ticket findings unverifiable on main

Three diagnostic files were landed on main as a dedicated change to make the measurement evidence durably accessible and verifiable, matching the established pattern of paired live-diagnostic drivers and findings write-ups in docs/experiments/

Completion-verifier runaway loops continue to occur on current main despite the runaway guard; the loop is caught after 12 consecutive repeat tool calls but root cause in context pre-selection remains unfixed
Budget-anchoring measurement confirms verifier converges at approximately 6 steps per criterion but does not stop when given excess budget, leading to redundant re-reading and guard activation
The diagnostic scripts are reusable and parameterized over step-floor values, enabling future re-runs against changes to verifier step-floor configuration without modification
